headline: Williamson Magor files SEBI dematerialisation compliance certificate for Q2 2026
hook: Routine quarterly filing submitted by Williamson Magor
summary: Williamson Magor has submitted its SEBI dematerialisation compliance certificate for the second quarter of fiscal 2026. The filing is a standard regulatory compliance requirement for listed companies. It provides procedural confirmation regarding the dematerialisation of shares. Retail investors generally do not see any direct financial impact from this procedural paperwork.
why_it_matters: No financial impact as this is standard regulatory paperwork.
